title: CWP/20268/2025 of SANDEEP Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 131 Date of decision: 21.07.2025 Sandeep ...Petitioner VERSUS State of Haryana and others ...Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD S. BHARDWAJ Present :- Mr. Vinay Rathee, Advocate for the petitioner(s). VINOD S. BHARDWAJ, J. (Oral)

1. Challenge in the present petition is to the revised result dated 28.05.2025 qua ESP (General Category) and speaking order dated 27.03.2025 qua the petitioner issued by the Haryana Staff Selection Commission, wherein his candidature is not being considered on the ground that the verification is still pending and his Roll No. as well as Category have also been shown incorrectly.

2. After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioner(s) submits that with regard to the grievance, the petitioner(s) has already submitted a representation dated 12.06.2025 (Annexure P-21) but no action has been thereupon till date. He contends that the petitioner(s) would be satisfied at this stage, in case respondent No.2-Secretary, Haryana Staff Selection Commission, is directed to consider and decide the said representation, in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion to the respondent(s)-State only at this stage. I am the author of this document 2 131 CWP-20268-2025 (O&M)

4. Mr. Rahul Dev, Addl. AG Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the respondent(s) and prays for some time to complete instructions and file response, if necessary. He, however, does not have any objection to the above request.

5. With the consent of the parties, the present petition is accordingly disposed of without commenting on the merits of the present case and with a direction to respondent No.2-Secretary, Haryana Staff Selection Commission to take note of the representation dated 12.06.2025 (Annexure P-21) sent by the petitioner in accordance with law, expeditiously and preferably within a period of 03 months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. (VINOD S. BHARDWAJ) 21.07.2025 JUDGE Mangal Singh I am the author of this document
